newsitem.title: USA: Commerce Bancshares non-performing assets up.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Bancshares non-performing assets up.

text.p: Commerce Bancshares Inc said Wednesday its total non-performing assets as of December 31 were $39.9 million, up from $33.9 million a year ago.
Loans 90-days and more past due totaled $24.8 million at year-end, up from $15.7 million a year ago.

Commerce Bancshares said its total non-performing assets stood at 0.73 percent of total loans and 0.41 percent of total assets as of December 31. These ratios were up from 0.64 percent of total loans and 0.35 percent of total assets as of year-end 1995.

"We continue to experience higher levels of net loan charge-offs in the personal loan categories in line with national trends," David Kemper, chairman, said in a statement. "However, overall asset quality remains excellent..."
He added that allowance for loan losses of $98.2 million was 1.79 percent of total loans and net charge-offs for the year were 0.47 percent of average loans.
Earlier, Commerce Bancshares reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.85 a share, up 20 percent from $0.71 a sahre ago. For the year, it earned $3.11 a share, up from $2.71 a year ago.

"We are pleased to report both record earnings for the sixth year in a row and strong earnings per share growth of 15 percent for the year," Kemper said. "Our fourth quarter results were especially strong with our efficiency ratio under 59 percent for the quarter."
He said this ratio has been improving all year as a result of initiatives to raise revenues and control expenses.
